name: analyze_feedback
description: Start or reuse complete analysis of the feedback sources and collection interval frozen in this task. This invokes budgeted background models. Read required video evidence first. PENDING is not analysis/report completion; the host waits and resumes, do not poll with model calls. No data is published.

video_evidence_id.description: Current-run video evidence required when VIDEO is selected. Must match the authorized playback range.

analysis_id.description: Optional explicitly referenced completed analysis UUID. Reuse requires current authorization and exact task compatibility; not an arbitrary result lookup.
